up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for CYP2A6, including the substrate structure, compound names, metabolic conversion, pathway, and organism.
sql:
SELECT
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism,
  md_substrate.pref_name AS substrate_name,
  md_metabolite.pref_name AS metabolite_name,
  cs_substrate.canonical_smiles AS substrate_smiles
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_substrate ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_substrate.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_substrate ON cr_substrate.molregno = md_substrate.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_substrate ON md_substrate.molregno = cs_substrate.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_metabolite ON m.metabolite_record_id = cr_metabolite.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_metabolite ON cr_metabolite.molregno = md_metabolite.molregno
WHERE m.enzyme_tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE pref_name LIKE 'CYP2A6%')
LIMIT 200;
